aiResearchSummary.text: Blue River Technology is researching and developing agricultural machines that use image sensors, machine-learned models, and control systems to identify, treat, and monitor plants in fields. Their work includes plant identification using dynamic cropping, plant group identification, compensatory actions for automated farming machine failure, precision application of crop treatments with configurable nozzles, and plant treatment based on morphological and physiological measurements. These areas reflect a focus on automation, precision agriculture, and machine learning.
